# Reproduction

Same WSL RTX 2080 Ti, cached official AWQ Qwen2.5-7B, serving venv from AGENTS.md. Everything is private under this directory; canonical dirty code is unchanged. No model downloads.

`PLAN-v3.json` contains the initial revised commands and dependency pins. Run `frontier.py --plan PLAN-v3.json` with the project venv only in a fresh copied evidence directory after adjusting absolute output paths and pins. Never overwrite prior runs. A completed response must pass the original strict proof validator; the runner stops on failures. Raw failures remain evidence and cannot enter a completed-load curve. `PLAN.json` has a failed ARC source-label setup; `PLAN-v2.json` has a client disconnect during the first actual ARC run. Those attempts are excluded, not rewritten.

Only the prefetch fraction changes in `run_frontier_defer.py` (default remains .6). `run_pressure.py` selects the frozen `sources/demand-headroom` candidate. That source subtracts the largest currently observed waiting/preempted prompt requirement from speculative free capacity. It never changes transfers, hashes, ownership, fence checks or the validator. This conservative rule does not model future demand or promise optimal headroom. CPU isolation tests in `test_headroom.py` exercise the actual extracted capacity method, including live progress and bounds.

`results.py` derives per-run measurements and exact cross-arm mismatch inventories; `plot.py` uses standalone matplotlib in temporary task-local packages, not installed into the serving environment. Historical curves are explicitly identified and not pooled as fresh controls. Generated histories can differ; then serving rates are descriptive workflows, not fixed-work causal estimates. The metric for usefulness is completed bytes consumed by the intended request divided by all explicitly completed speculative bytes; unrelated reuse is not credited.

`FOLLOWUP.json` tests backoff at768; ARC1536 failed strict physical metadata proof, so its two planned candidate runs were not launched. `KNEE.json` moves all three arms to2048. `CONFIRM.json` adds default60% and two more cap15/ARC partitions. All histories and exclusions are retained. `results.py` and `report.py` regenerate tables/report; run analysis only after GPU work has shut down. `SOURCE-PINS.json` records final tool/source identities. Plotting requirements are frozen in `PLOT_REQUIREMENTS.txt`; install into a new task-local target for reproduction, then remove it after export.
